                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • କ୍ଷୀର ବିଭିନ୍ନ ରୂପରେ ବ୍ୟାପକ ଭାବରେ ସେବନ କରାଯାଏ, ଯେପରିକି ପନିର, ଦହି, ଏବଂ ଲହୁଣୀ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ଭିନେଗାର\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ଭିନେଗାର ମୁଖ୍ୟତଃ ଆସେଟିକ୍ ଏସିଡ୍ରେ ଗଠିତ, ଯାହା ଏହାକୁ ଏହାର ସ୍ୱତନ୍ତ୍ର ତୀବ୍ର ଗନ୍ଧ ଏବଂ ଖଟା ସ୍ୱାଦ ଦେଇଥାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ଏହା ରୋଷେଇ, ସଫା, ଏବଂ ଖାଦ୍ୟ ସଂରକ୍ଷଣରେ ବ୍ୟାପକ ଭାବରେ ବ୍ୟବହୃତ ହୁଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • ଅକ୍ସାଲିକ୍ ଏସିଡ୍ ପରି, ଆସେଟିକ୍ ଏସିଡ୍ ଏକ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଏସିଡ୍ ଏବଂ ଏହାର ଅନେକ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ ଉପକାର ଅଛି, ଯେଉଁଥିରେ ରକ୍ତ ଶର୍କରା ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣରେ ସାହାଯ୍ୟ କରିବା।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n13b:Te1c,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                The Correct answer is CaSO4 · 1/2H2O.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • CaSO4 · 1/2H2O is commonly known as Plaster of Paris (POP).
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • It is made by heating gypsum (CaSO4 · 2H2O) to about 150°C, which removes water molecules to form CaSO4 · 1/2H2O.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • When mixed with water, Plaster of Paris rehydrates to form a hard mass, which is ideal for setting fractured bones and making casts or molds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Doctors use it to create orthopedic casts for immobilizing fractured bones, as it sets quickly and is lightweight.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • Plaster of Paris is also extensively used in construction, artwork, and decorative materials due to its ability to set and form intricate designs.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • This material is non-toxic, making it suitable for medical applications, including fracture treatment and surgical molds.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • ZnSO4 · 7H2O\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • This compound is known as Zinc Sulfate Heptahydrate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It is used in fertilizers, animal feed supplements, and as a dietary supplement for zinc deficiency.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It has no medical application in orthopedic treatments.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • CuSO4 · 5H2O\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • This compound is commonly called Blue Vitriol or Copper Sulfate Pentahydrate.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  • It is used as a The correct answer is Tamarind.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Tartaric acid is a naturally occurring organic acid found in tamarind.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Tamarind pulp contains high amounts of tartaric acid, giving it a distinctive sour taste.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • This acid is widely used as a flavoring agent in foods and beverages due to its sourness.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Tartaric acid also acts as a natural preservative in many culinary applications.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • It is commonly used in the preparation of pickles, sauces, and certain traditional dishes where tamarind is a key ingredient.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Tartaric Acid:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Tartaric acid is a white crystalline organic acid commonly found in plants, particularly in grapes, bananas, and tamarind.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It is widely used in the food industry as an acidulant, stabilizer, and emulsifier.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • In winemaking, tartaric acid plays a crucial role in maintaining the wine's chemical stability and taste.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Other Natural Sources of Tartaric Acid:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Besides tamarind, tartaric acid is also present in small amounts in grapes, apricots, and other fruits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It is a key component in cream of tartar, a by-product of winemaking.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Health Benefits of Tartaric Acid:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It acts as an antioxidant, helping to neutralize harmful free radicals in the body.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It aids in digestion and improves the absorption of nutrients.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • Uses in Daily Life:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • Tartaric acid is used in baking as a leavening agent when combined with baking soda.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • It is also employed in the pharmaceutical industry for the preparation of effervescent tablets.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    सही उत्तर इमली है।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Key Points 

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • टार्टरिक अम्ल इमली में पाया जाने वाला एक प्राकृतिक कार्बनिक अम्ल है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • इमली के गूदे में टार्टरिक अम्ल की उच्च मात्रा होती है, जो इसे एक विशिष्ट खट्टा स्वाद देती है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • इस अम्ल का व्यापक रूप से खाद्य पदार्थों और पेय पदार्थों में स्वाद बढ़ाने वाले एजेंट के रूप में उपयोग किया जाता है क्योंकि यह खट्टा होता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • टार्टरिक अम्ल कई पाक अनुप्रयोगों में प्राकृतिक परिरक्षक के रूप में भी कार्य करता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • यह आमतौर पर अचार, सॉस और कुछ पारंपरिक व्यंजनों की तैयारी में उपयोग किया जाता है जहाँ इमली एक प्रमुख घटक है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • टार्टरिक अम्ल:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • टार्टरिक अम्ल एक सफेद क्रिस्टलीय कार्बनिक अम्ल है जो आमतौर पर पौधों में, विशेष रूप से अंगूर, केले और इमली में पाया जाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • यह खाद्य उद्योग में एक अम्लीय, स्थिर करने वाला और पायसीकारी के रूप में व्यापक रूप से उपयोग किया जाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • वाइनमेकिंग में, टार्टरिक अम्ल वाइन की रासायनिक स्थिरता और स्वाद को बनाए रखने में महत्वपूर्ण भूमिका निभाता है।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    • टार्टरिक अम्ल के अन्य प्राकृतिक स्रोत:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      • इमली के अलावा, टार्टरिक अम्ल अंगूर, खुबानी और अन्य फलों में भी थोड़ी मात्रा में मौजूद होता है।
