                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ସମଜାତୀୟ ମିଶ୍ରଣ\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ଏକ ସମଜାତୀୟ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ହେଉଛି ଏକ ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଯେଉଁଠାରେ ଉପାଦାନଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଆଣବିକ ସ୍ତରରେ ସମାନ ଭାବରେ ବଣ୍ଟନ ହୋଇଥାନ୍ତି, ଫଳରେ ଏକ ସମାନ ଗଠନ ମିଳିଥାଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ଉଦାହରଣ ସ୍ୱରୂପ, ଜଳରେ ମିଶାଯାଇଥିବା ଚିନି, ଲୁଣିଆ ଜଳ ଏବଂ ବାୟୁ ପରି ଦ୍ରବଣଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ବିସମଜାତୀୟ ମିଶ୍ରଣ\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ଏକ ବିସମଜାତୀୟ ମିଶ୍ରଣରେ, ଉପାଦାନଗୁଡ଼ିକ ଅଲଗା ରହିଥାନ୍ତି ଏବଂ ପ୍ରାୟତଃ ଦୃଶ୍ୟମାନ ଭାବରେ ଭିନ୍ନ କରାଯାଇପାରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ଉଦାହରଣ ସ୍ୱରୂପ, ବାଲି ଏବଂ ଜଳ, ତେଲ ଏବଂ ଜଳ, ଏବଂ ମାଟି ମିଶ୍ରଣ ଅନ୍ତର୍ଭୁକ୍ତ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • ତରଳ ପଦାର୍ଥରେ ଗ୍ୟାସର ଦ୍ରବଣୀୟତା\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ତରଳ ପଦାର୍ଥରେ ଗ୍ୟାସର ଦ୍ରବଣୀୟତା ଚାପ, ତାପମାତ୍ରା ଏବଂ ଗ୍ୟାସ ଓ ତରଳ ପଦାର୍ଥର ପ୍ରକୃତି ପରି କାରକ ଉପରେ ନିର୍ଭର କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ଉଚ୍ଚ ଚାପ ଗ୍ୟାସର ଦ୍ରବଣୀୟତା ବଢାଏ, ଯାହା କାର୍ବୋନେଟେଡ୍ ପାନୀୟରେ ଦେଖାଯାଏ ଯେଉଁଠାରେ CO₂ ଚାପରେ ଦ୍ରବୀଭୂତ ହୁଏ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • କାର୍ବନିକ୍ ଏସିଡ୍ (H₂CO₃)\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ଯେତେବେଳେ CO₂ ଜଳରେ ଦ୍ରବୀଭୂତ ହୁଏ, ଏହା ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା କରି କାର୍ବନିକ୍ ଏସିଡ୍ ଗଠନ କରେ, ଯାହା ଏକ ଦୁର୍ବଳ ଅମ୍ଳ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • ଏହି ପ୍ରତିକ୍ରିୟା ପ୍ରତିବର୍ତ୍ତନୀୟ ଏବଂ ପ୍ରାକୃତିକ ଜଳାଶୟ ଏବଂ ଜୀବନ୍ତ ଜୀବଙ୍କ ରକ୍ତରେ pH ନିୟନ୍ତ୍ରଣ କରିବାରେ ଏକ ଭୂମିକା ଗ୍ରହଣ କରେ।
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n18c:Tc0c,\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The correct answer is Tamarind.

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Tartaric acid is a naturally occurring organic acid found in tamarind.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Tamarind pulp contains high amounts of tartaric acid, giving it a distinctive sour taste.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • This acid is widely used as a flavoring agent in foods and beverages due to its sourness.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Tartaric acid also acts as a natural preservative in many culinary applications.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • It is commonly used in the preparation of pickles, sauces, and certain traditional dishes where tamarind is a key ingredient.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Tartaric Acid:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Tartaric acid is a white crystalline organic acid commonly found in plants, particularly in grapes, bananas, and tamarind.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • It is widely used in the food industry as an acidulant, stabilizer, and emulsifier.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • In winemaking, tartaric acid plays a crucial role in maintaining the wine's chemical stability and taste.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        • Other Natural Sources of Tartaric Acid:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          • Besides tamarind, tartaric acid is also present in small amounts in grapes, apricots, and other fruits.
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • \n\t\t

"solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            The correct answer is The system shifts in the direction that opposes the change to re-establish equilibrium..

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Le Chatelier's Principle states that if a dynamic equilibrium is disturbed by changing the conditions, the position of equilibrium moves to counteract the change and restore equilibrium. (Source: Chemistry LibreTexts)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • This principle applies to changes in concentration, pressure, and temperature. (Source: Royal Society of Chemistry)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • In response to a change in concentration, the system will shift to consume the added substance or produce more of the removed substance. (Source: Khan Academy)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • When pressure is altered, the equilibrium will shift towards the side with fewer or more moles of gas, depending on whether pressure is increased or decreased. (Source: BBC Bitesize)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • For changes in temperature, the system will shift towards the endothermic or exothermic direction to absorb or release heat accordingly. (Source: CK-12 Foundation)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Additional Information

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Dynamic Equilibrium:\n\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • It is a state in which the forward and reverse reactions occur at the same rate, resulting in no net change in the concentrations of reactants and products. (Source: Chemguide)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Endothermic and Exothermic Reactions:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Endothermic reactions absorb heat, while exothermic reactions release heat. (Source: National Geographic)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • The direction of shift in equilibrium depends on whether the reaction is endothermic or exothermic when temperature changes. (Source: ThoughtCo)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Concentration Changes:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Adding more reactants or removing products will shift equilibrium towards the products side. (Source: Chem4Kids)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Conversely, adding more products or removing reactants will shift equilibrium towards the reactants side. (Source: Chem4Kids)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Pressure Changes:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Increasing pressure favors the side with fewer moles of gas, while decreasing pressure favors the side with more moles of gas. (Source: Chemguide)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • Temperature Changes:\n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                \n\t\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • Increasing temperature favors the endothermic direction, while decreasing temperature favors the exothermic direction. (Source: Chemistry LibreTexts)
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                • \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              • \n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            ", "hn": "\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            सही उत्तर है तंत्र उस दिशा में विस्थापित होगा जो परिवर्तन का विरोध करता है ताकि पुनः साम्य स्थापित हो सके।

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Key Points

                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            \n\n
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              \n\t
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            • ला-शातेलिए का सिद्धांत कहता है कि यदि किसी गतिशील साम्य को परिस्थितियों में परिवर्तन करके बाधित किया जाता है, तो साम्य की स्थिति परिवर्तन का प्रतिकार करने और साम्य को बहाल करने के लिए आगे बढ़ती है। (स्रोत: केमिस्ट्री लिब्रेटेक्स्ट)
